kind.description: All CLC-D cross-walk vectors assert Contains over a mapped carrier pair.

profile.description: Pinned cross-walk profile mapping parent and child native representations to CLC grants.

parent_source.description: Carrier-native parent boundary representation, mapped by the profile.

child_source.description: Carrier-native child (requested) representation, mapped by the profile.

out_of_scope.description: Carrier identity/policy dimensions the profile does not map into a CLC field and therefore declares out of scope (core §13.8.1 obligation 3). The runner MUST fail if any declared dimension still reaches a mapped grant — a dimension the relation cannot see must not be silently dropped, and a profile must not report containment for it.

reason.description: Expected reason on a false result (child_exceeds_parent / params_not_narrower / different_namespace).

map_error.description: Expected profile-level failure code raised before the containment relation (for example linkage_mismatch, or the catch-all mapping_failed). When present, contains is not evaluated.
